topics.name: Neural networks basics
topics.description: Foundations of artificial neural networks, activation, backpropagation, and architectures.

topics.name: Transformers and attention
topics.description: Sequence modeling, self-attention mechanisms, encoder-decoder architectures, and pre-training.

topics.name: Prompting and RAG basics
topics.description: Prompt engineering strategies, dense vector embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval augmentation.

concepts.name: Perceptron
concepts.description: The fundamental linear unit combining weighted inputs, bias, and a threshold activation.

concepts.name: Vectors and matrices for ML
concepts.description: Dot products, matrix multiplication, vector spaces, and dimensions in neural networks.

concepts.name: Activation functions
concepts.description: Non-linear mappings (Sigmoid, ReLU, GELU, Tanh) enabling multi-layer feature representations.

concepts.name: Loss functions
concepts.description: Objective functions including MSE, Binary Cross-Entropy, and Categorical Cross-Entropy.

concepts.name: Gradient descent
concepts.description: Iterative optimization via loss gradients, learning rates, and step updates.

concepts.name: Backpropagation
concepts.description: Application of the multivariable calculus chain rule to compute gradients across layered graphs.

concepts.name: Hidden layers and network depth
concepts.description: Stacking dense layers, representation learning, and expressivity vs parameter count.

concepts.name: Overfitting and generalization
concepts.description: Train vs validation divergence, bias-variance tradeoff, and model capacity.

concepts.name: Dropout
concepts.description: Regularization by randomly zeroing activations during forward passes in training.

concepts.name: Batch normalization
concepts.description: Normalizing layer inputs by mini-batch mean and variance to stabilize training.

concepts.name: Convolutional layers
concepts.description: Spatial weight sharing, convolutional kernels, stride, padding, and feature maps.

concepts.name: Pooling and receptive field
concepts.description: Max-pooling, average-pooling, spatial dimension downsampling, and receptive fields.

concepts.name: Training loop and mini-batches
concepts.description: Forward pass, loss computation, backward pass, optimizer step, and epoch tracking.

concepts.name: Optimizers (SGD, Adam)
concepts.description: Momentum, adaptive learning rates, RMSProp, and Adam optimization mechanics.

concepts.name: Tokenization
concepts.description: Subword splitting algorithms including BPE, WordPiece, and SentencePiece.

concepts.name: Token embeddings
concepts.description: Mapping discrete token IDs into continuous high-dimensional vector representations.

concepts.name: Sequence-to-sequence modeling
concepts.description: Encoder-decoder formulation for mapping variable-length input sequences to output sequences.

concepts.name: Attention intuition
concepts.description: Dynamic content-based weighting across sequence positions rather than static bottleneck vectors.

concepts.name: Scaled dot-product attention
concepts.description: Mathematical formula: Softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) * V and why sqrt(d_k) scaling matters.

concepts.name: Query, Key, and Value projections
concepts.description: Linear transformation projections that unpack contextual roles of each token.

concepts.name: Multi-head attention
concepts.description: Parallel attention heads attending to distinct representation subspaces and relation types.

concepts.name: Positional encoding
concepts.description: Injecting permutation-invariant models with order signals via sinusoidal or learned encodings.

concepts.name: Transformer encoder
concepts.description: Stacked multi-head self-attention, feed-forward networks, residual connections, and LayerNorm.

concepts.name: Transformer decoder
concepts.description: Causal masked self-attention, cross-attention over encoder outputs, and autoregressive generation.

concepts.name: Pre-training objectives (MLM, CLM)
concepts.description: Self-supervised objectives: Masked Language Modeling vs Causal Autoregressive Language Modeling.

concepts.name: Fine-tuning and transfer learning
concepts.description: Adapting general pre-trained weights to specific downstream supervised tasks and domains.

concepts.name: BERT vs GPT architectural families
concepts.description: Encoder-only bidirectional architectures vs Decoder-only autoregressive models.

concepts.name: Prompt anatomy and instructions
concepts.description: Structure of prompts: instructions, input context, constraints, and output formatting directives.

concepts.name: Zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning
concepts.description: Direct task prompting vs providing exemplar input-output demonstrations in prompt context.

concepts.name: Chain-of-thought prompting
concepts.description: Eliciting multi-step reasoning trails prior to final answer generation (CoT, zero-shot CoT).

concepts.name: System vs user prompt boundaries
concepts.description: Role separation, persistent persona definitions, and safety guardrails across conversation turns.

concepts.name: Temperature and sampling hyperparameters
concepts.description: Softmax scaling with temperature, Top-P (nucleus), and Top-K sampling mechanics.

concepts.name: Hallucination and factual grounding
concepts.description: Causes of generative confabulation and techniques for grounding responses in verifiable source text.

concepts.name: Dense text embeddings for retrieval
concepts.description: Semantic sentence transformers, cosine similarity, inner products, and Euclidean distance.

concepts.name: Vector databases and indexing
concepts.description: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search, HNSW graphs, IVF, and similarity indexes.

concepts.name: Document chunking strategies
concepts.description: Fixed-size, sentence-level, semantic, and recursive character splitting with overlap windows.

concepts.name: Dense retrieval step
concepts.description: Query embedding, top-k candidate retrieval from vector index, and relevance scoring.

concepts.name: Context injection and prompt augmentation
concepts.description: Synthesizing retrieved document chunks into prompt context windows with attribution instructions.

concepts.name: End-to-end RAG architecture
concepts.description: Complete ingestion, indexing, retrieval, augmentation, and generative response orchestration.

concepts.name: Re-ranking and cross-encoders
concepts.description: Two-stage retrieval: bi-encoder candidate retrieval followed by heavy cross-encoder scoring.
